info.title: logaffe
info.description: The read and write surface of one logaffe installation. Every installation is at its own address.

get.summary: Whether the installation can serve.
Whether this installation has an operator, and how it can be claimed.

post.summary: Gives this installation an operator, and signs them in.
Starts a session for the operator.
Ends the session this request was made with.
Takes a batch of log entries for the project its token names.
Takes one reading from the collector on the host its token names.

get.summary: The operator's signed-in browsers.

delete.summary: Ends every session but this one.

put.summary: Takes a new password, and ends every other session.

post.summary: Replaces the backup codes with a fresh set, shown once.

get.summary: Whether the operator has a second factor, and since when.

put.summary: Enrols or replaces the second factor, issues fresh backup codes, and ends every other session.

post.summary: Draws a second factor and a sheet of backup codes, and stores neither.
Removes the second factor and its backup codes, and ends every other session.
Brings a project into existence, which is the only way one comes about.

get.summary: Every project the installation holds.
One project, which is what its settings are reached by.

patch.summary: Gives a project another name; the identity is not one.

delete.summary: Ends a project, immediately and irreversibly.

put.summary: Lists a project under another group, or under none.
Says which machine a project runs on, or that none is tracked.
Takes a project out of the alert conditions, or puts it back in.

get.summary: How many entries a retention window would remove, before it is applied.
What a retention window will cost, before it is applied.

put.summary: Changes how long a project keeps its entries.

post.summary: Makes a group, which is the only way one comes about.

get.summary: Every group the installation holds.

patch.summary: Gives a group another name; the identity is not one.

delete.summary: Removes a group and leaves its projects in none.

get.summary: One page of a project's entries, newest first by event time.
What has arrived since the last poll, in the view's order.
How many entries a filter set matches, optionally grouped.
One entry in full, with its exception and its properties.

post.summary: Brings a host into existence, which is the only way one comes about.

get.summary: Every host the installation holds.

patch.summary: Gives a host another name; the identity is not one.

delete.summary: Ends a host and the history of the machine behind it.

get.summary: What one host reported over a range, in equal spans.
The filesystems one machine last reported on.
How long this installation keeps every host's samples.

put.summary: Changes how long this installation keeps every host's samples.

get.summary: How many samples a retention window would remove, before it is applied.
What a sample retention window will cost, before it is applied.

post.summary: Gives a project a token to receive on.

get.summary: What one project can currently receive on.
The token that is in the row, and the delivery to paste it in.

post.summary: Gives an agent a token to read or to administer with.

get.summary: Every agent token the installation holds.

patch.summary: Gives an agent token another label.

get.summary: The token that is in the row, and the configuration to paste it in.

post.summary: Gives a host a token its collector can report on.

get.summary: What one host can currently receive samples on.
The token that is in the row, and the command to paste it in.
The switches, what each of them currently does, and what last fired.

put.summary: Switches the three conditions on, or off.
Says which machine this installation sits on, and on which mount.
Names the one place this installation's notifications go.

delete.summary: Takes the notifier away, and the sealed token with it.

get.summary: The access token this installation publishes with, in the clear.

post.summary: Sends the shape a real alert has, and says how it went.
